li.label: sent to bed at sundown
li.description: The best hours of the day are after dark, and the council has banned them.

li.label: quiet hours
li.description: Lamps out and no talking after dark. The evenings are long and dull.

li.label: peaceful evenings
li.description: No banging, no shouting after dark. I sleep better.

li.label: blessed quiet
li.description: For once the colony is quiet at night, and I can hear myself think. I sleep through till morning.

li.label: forced to eat with everyone
li.description: I have to sit at the same table as all of them, every meal, and listen to them chew.

li.label: meals by the bell
li.description: We all eat at the same time now, whether we're hungry or not.

li.label: meals together
li.description: The whole table full, every evening. I like the noise of it.

li.label: one table, one family
li.description: We eat together now, all of us, every meal. This is what I wanted this place to be.

li.label: ordered to lie down
li.description: The council would put me to bed over a sniffle. There's work to do and I'm being made to watch it pile up.

li.label: the sick-bay rule
li.description: Too many of us are in bed with something, and the rest are covering for them.

li.label: looking after the sick
li.description: The sick rest and the well cover for them. That's how it should be.

li.label: allowed to get better
li.description: When I'm ill, I'm allowed to stay in bed until I'm well. Nobody looks at me sideways for it.

li.label: cold rooms, dark nights
li.description: The fires are down to embers and the lamps go out at dusk. I'm cold all the time, and it's dark by supper.

li.label: banked fires
li.description: The fires are kept low to save fuel. I wear my coat indoors now.

li.label: a careful hearth
li.description: We're not wasting fuel anymore. The woodpile will see us through.

li.label: not a stick wasted
li.description: Every log burns all the way down now. Good. We've wasted enough.

li.label: stuck teaching fools
li.description: Somebody is always at my elbow asking how, and doing it wrong. I can't get my own work done.

li.label: lessons every day
li.description: Lessons in everything, every day, on top of my own work.

li.label: learning from each other
li.description: Everyone is teaching everyone something. I've learned more this week than in the last season.

li.label: passing on the trades
li.description: I'm teaching what I know and learning what others know. This colony will be better for it.

li.label: a wasteful feast
li.description: They're eating a week's food in a day while the work sits there. I can't enjoy any of it.

li.label: a feast I didn't ask for
li.description: Too much food and not enough work done. I'll eat it, but I don't like it.

li.label: feast day
li.description: A day off and a full table. I ate too much.

li.label: a proper feast
li.description: The best of everything, as much as I could eat, and the whole afternoon to eat it. What a day.
